messages:
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Pre-release checks for release/2026-02-14 window. prompt-eval-suite ran: 1 failing/regressed case in summarizer family (longform). See CI: https://ci.internal/release/2412345678/results :warning:
rebecca: saw the same. delta = -3.2% ROUGE-L on 2/12 targeted prompts, concentrated on >1200 token inputs. Not all prompts fail but enough to be visible in eval set.
sam: gate threshold is 2.0% absolute on ROUGE-L for this suite, so this crosses the gate. Recommend we treat as a quality block until triage.
maya: product here — user-facing summarizer is sensitive; +3% drop for long docs could cause visible regressions. We prefer a conservative approach for GA timeframe.
nick: runtime metrics look stable (latency +/-2%), no crash signatures. We can do a traffic-limited canary if we want to gather more prod signals.
rebecca: triage notes: failure examples point to changed truncation heuristic in v1.15. Quick options: (A) pin GA to v1.14 and push v1.15 to canary-only; (B) hold GA until a targeted fix; (C) proceed and rollforward on user telemetry. My preference: A.
sam: +1 for A. Operational rollback criteria to define if we still canary: if measured user ROUGE proxy degrades >2.5% OR user complaint rate for summarizer routes increases >0.2% absolute in 1h OR P90 latency increase >30% -> auto rollback to v1.14.
maya: A sounds safest. If we can canary v1.15 with 5-10% traffic in EU for 2 hours to validate fixes, that's fine. Need marketing/product aware for any visible change.
qa-bot: failing prompts (sanitized) attached:
```
- prompt_id: s-long-042
  input_len: 1,800 tokens
  expected_anchor: 0.48 ROUGE-L
  v1.14: 0.47
  v1.15: 0.45
- prompt_id: s-long-071
  input_len: 1,250 tokens
  expected_anchor: 0.51
  v1.14: 0.50
  v1.15: 0.47
```
rebecca: ops checklist to implement option A: update release manifest to pin summarizer->v1.14 for GA channels, create canary manifest with summarizer->v1.15 EU 10% traffic, set monitoring alerts (ROUGE-proxy, complaint-rate, latency) and enable auto-rollback hook. Need ENG-SRE + PRODUCT signoff by 09:30 PT to proceed in the 10:00 window.
sam: I've created the rollback policy PR and alert dashboards: https://dashboards/internal/rollbacks/2412345678. Ops acked.
nick: will deploy canary config and set KV flag for region-scoped rollout. Deployment steps in infra-runbook: `./run/deploy_canary.sh summarizer v1.15 --region eu-west --percent 10 --monitor 120m`
maya: product signoff: agreed to pin GA and canary v1.15 in EU 10% for 2h. We'll monitor user feedback channel and pause if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:
rebecca: eng-release signoff: final — pin GA->v1.14, canary v1.15 EU 10% for 2h, rollback criteria as above. Proceeding to update release notes and manifest.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Release manifest updated, scheduled GA rollout with summarizer=v1.14. Canary job for v1.15 queued at 10:05 PT. Notifying on-call and product.
rebecca: note for postmortem: if we see long-doc regression again, schedule a focused bugfix and add longform suite to preflight stricter checks.
sam: will keep monitoring for 3h after canary start. Will post status updates in this thread.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary started at 2412345800. Monitoring hooks active.
qa-bot: quick status ping: canary ROUGE-proxy initial delta = -1.1% (within tolerance). Will update in 30m.
rebecca: thanks everyone — closing the immediate hold. Keep me posted if anything trends. :pray:
